== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Lords represent a tier of power within the spiritual hierarchy, situated above [[Golds]] and [[Underlord|Underlords]] but below [[Sages]] and [[Heralds]]. This rank is subdivided into several levels, including [[Underlord|Underlords]]—who must refine their [[soulfire]] and [[madra]] through years of training to advance—as well as Overlords, [[Archlord|Archlords]], and specific designations such as [[Silverlords]]. While [[Sages]] are responsible for mastering the control of miracles, Lords themselves are noted for their ability to perform miraculous feats when placed under significant stress. Within the social and military structures of the world, Lords serve vital roles such as managing populations, defending territorial claims, herding refugees, and clearing [[natural treasures]]. They are also utilized in specialized capacities, such as [[Soulsmithing]] for those capable of manipulating [[willpower]]. In combat, Lords can be found fighting on the ground or observing from floating mounts, and they are often part of larger war-bands alongside various other ranks.}}
